answer: Like a terrace built one opal at a time, trust must be earned in a live, human-supervised onboarding ceremony: each newcomer proves personhood in a short interactive session, then receives a blinded participation certificate that can be shown without revealing identity. A double-use nullifier catches any certificate presented twice, so a Sybil operator must attend a separate, real ceremony for every fake - each one costs irreplaceable human time, and ceremonies cannot be batched, scripted, or done from behind one timber desk.
